desc: Implement input parsing and BFS from S and T for distS/distT.
Implement iterative Tarjan biconnected components and build the block-cut tree with all original vertices and one node per block; find the S-T path and mark corridor vertices.
Implement degree-based candidates: +2 for corridor non-endpoint vertices with degree >= 3, and +4 for endpoint or non-corridor vertices with degree >= 3.

Implement path-block cycle candidates: simple-cycle blocks by edge count, and non-cycle blocks by pruned 2-unit min-cost flow with vertex splitting to get the shortest cycle through the two path ports.
Integrate all candidates, print the minimum or -1, and ensure the program runs on the three sample inputs.
Stress-test against brute-force state BFS on small random graphs and check performance/memory for N,M up to 2e5.
